universal_lifecycle_stages.contract_outputs: T1, T2, SL in Tradable Basis

universal_lifecycle_stages.contract_inputs: High/Low since Entry in Contract Price

four_independent_timestamps.T_CREATE: Exact microsecond timestamp when scanner identified candle close pattern and created signal record
four_independent_timestamps.T_ENTRY_VALID_FROM: Timestamp when signal becomes active for order execution (e.g. at confirmation candle open)
four_independent_timestamps.T_ENTRY_VALID_UNTIL: Entry By deadline (e.g. T_CREATE + 15 min for Swing, +5 min for Options); order cancels if unfilled
four_independent_timestamps.T_POSITION_EXPIRY: Absolute position horizon (15:15 IST intraday, 5 trading days for Swing, or contract expiry date)

feasibility_engine_specification.evaluation_rule: Fail-Closed: If required market data or metrics are missing, returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA and blocks emission

category_logic.EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY: Passes if Target T1 (4.0%) <= 0.8 * (5 * Daily ATR). Checks that entry price is not extended > 3% from 20 EMA.
category_logic.INDEX_OPTIONS: Evaluates genuine Option Premium Target (+25%). Passes if Underlying Expected Move * Delta >= Target Premium Move and Theta Decay * Expected Hours <= 0.20 * Target Premium.
category_logic.STOCK_OPTIONS: Passes if Stock Expected Move * Delta >= Target Premium Move and Open Interest >= 1,000 contracts.
category_logic.FUTURES: Passes if Contract Target (1.0x ATR) <= Remaining Daily Expected Range.
category_logic.LOW_SAMPLE: Returns INSUFFICIENT_DATA / OBSERVATION_ONLY until sample size >= 100.

P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.current_behavior: Emits synthetic symbol string with cash spot index price (e.g. 23500) and +4% spot target.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.desired_behavior: Calls core/option_chain_json.py to resolve ATM/1-OTM contract, fetches live premium LTP from core/live_option_quotes.py, sets premium targets (+25%).
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.data_contract: Emits tradable_symbol = contract name, price = option LTP, target_1 = LTP * 1.25.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.test_strategy: Unit test in tests/test_index_option_truth.py asserting contract LTP and Greeks exist on every emitted alert.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.rollback_strategy: Feature flag GENUINE_OPTION_RESOLVER_ENABLED = False fallback to disabled state.

P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.current_behavior: Tags cash equities in FNO_EQUITY_STOCKS as STOCK_OPTIONS, measuring spot price against +4% intraday.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.desired_behavior: Reclassifies cash equities to EQUITY_INTRADAY (or EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY), or resolves genuine stock option chain contract.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.data_contract: Clear separation: Cash stocks emit cash category; derivative options emit option contract payload.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.test_strategy: Regression test in tests/test_stock_option_taxonomy.py verifying no cash equity is tagged as STOCK_OPTIONS without contract.

P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.item: Futures Contract Resolution & Generator Price Truth
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.current_behavior: Inherited parent_signal.price (cash spot) while contract resolver tracked futures bars.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.desired_behavior: Scanner fetches near-month canonical contract quote via FuturesContractResolver.resolve_contract() before alert generation.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.data_contract: Alert entry_price, target_1, and stop_loss in contract points.
P0_INSTRUMENT_TRUTH.test_strategy: Test in tests/test_futures_contract_pricing.py asserting zero spot price contamination in futures alerts.

P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.current_behavior: No feasibility checks exist; alerts emitted blindly with static percentage targets.
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.desired_behavior: Evaluates volatility, range consumed, session remaining, and liquidity; blocks infeasible signals with machine-readable reasons.
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.test_strategy: Unit tests in tests/test_target_feasibility_engine.py simulating various ATR and range conditions.

P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.item: Entry Validity & Drift Window Guard ('Entry By')
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.current_behavior: No entry expiration; delayed orders execute with severe price drift and inverted R:R.
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.desired_behavior: Enforces T_ENTRY_VALID_UNTIL (15 min for swing, 5 min for options) and max drift threshold (0.5%).
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.data_contract: Rejects orders if current_time > T_ENTRY_VALID_UNTIL or abs(price - trigger)/trigger > max_drift.
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.test_strategy: Unit tests in tests/test_entry_validity.py asserting drift cancellation.
P1_TARGET_FEASIBILITY.rollback_strategy: Disable drift guard via config flag.

P2_SIGNAL_QUALITY.current_behavior: Global +4% T1, +8% T2, -3% SL applied across all instruments.
P2_SIGNAL_QUALITY.desired_behavior: Applies category-specific models: ATR-based for Futures, Premium-based for Options, preserved +4/+8/-3 for Equity Swing.
P2_SIGNAL_QUALITY.test_strategy: Parametric tests across all 10 categories in tests/test_target_sl_builder.py.

P3_FUTURE_CALIBRATION.current_behavior: Heuristic setup score (e.g. 92) conflated with target probability.
P3_FUTURE_CALIBRATION.desired_behavior: Isotonic regression / calibrated logistic model estimating true P(T1 before SL and Expiry) using point-in-time features.
P3_FUTURE_CALIBRATION.data_contract: Returns probability float [0.0 - 1.0] with calibration confidence interval.
P3_FUTURE_CALIBRATION.test_strategy: Brier score and log-loss evaluation on holdout forward sets (N >= 200).
P3_FUTURE_CALIBRATION.rollback_strategy: Display probability as None / Unsupported until sample gate met.
